column1: # ZAP rule configuration for the CI job `dast` (baseline and API scan).
# Format: rule id <TAB> IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL <TAB> rule name. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Rules not listed here are WARN: they show in the reports but do not fail the job
# (the scans run with -I). FAIL is reserved for what the stack already guarantees
# (Caddyfile headers, Django cookie settings) and for injection findings, so a
# regression fails the job. Every IGNORE says why.
# Headers the Caddyfile sets on every response.

column1: # Cookies: Django sets Secure (SESSION_/CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE) and SameSite=Lax.
# 10010 stays WARN: the csrftoken cookie is readable by the web app on purpose
# (it sends it back as X-CSRFToken); the session cookie is HttpOnly.
# Active scan (API scan only): injection findings are never acceptable.
# 10035: Caddy sends max-age=0 while the server uses its private CA (BRIEVIE_HSTS_SECONDS,
# see the Caddyfile): a browser must be able to pass the certificate warning.
# 10027: matches words like 'user' or 'select' in the minified Vite bundle; there is
# no server-side comment to leak, the bundle is the published AGPL source.
# 10096: matches large numbers in the bundle (constants, hashes) as Unix timestamps.
# 10109: only says the page is a single-page app, which is known.
